user.title: User
user.description: Represents a user in the system.

uid.description: The user's unique ID from Firebase Auth.

role.description: The user's role, as stored in Firestore. The source of truth for authorization is the custom claim.

companyId.description: ID of the company the user belongs to.

company.title: Company
company.description: Represents a company using the system.

ownerUid.description: The UID of the admin user who owns the company.

work.title: Work
work.description: Represents a specific job or construction site.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this work belongs to.

startDate.description: The start date of the work.

endDate.description: The end date of the work.

workLocationDetails.description: Details about the specific location or floor of the work.

employee.title: Employee
employee.description: Represents an employee of a company.

company.description: Name of the subcontracting company, if applicable.

companyId.description: The ID of the company this employee belongs to.

document.title: Safety Document
document.description: Represents a generated safety document (APR or PT).

workId.description: The ID of the work this document is for.

formData.description: The raw form data used to generate the document.

analysisData.description: The AI-generated analysis data for APRs.

equipmentData.description: The AI-generated equipment recommendations for APRs.

errorLog.title: Error Log
errorLog.description: Represents a log of an error that occurred in the application for debugging purposes.

functionName.description: The name of the function where the error was caught (e.g., 'signUp', 'signIn').

userEmail.description: The email of the user involved, if available.

errorCode.description: The specific error code from Firebase or other services.

stackTrace.description: The stack trace of the error, if available.

role.description: Defines the user's role in the system.

values.admin: Grants access to administrative routes and functionalities.
values.user: Default role for standard users with access to document generation.

companyId.description: Associates a user with a specific company.

/companies/{companyId}/employees/{employ.description: Stores employees for a specific company.

/works/{workId}.description: Stores information about each work site, belonging to a company.
